title: The normalized Hom comparison on chain maps into Hom
statement: For the ringed sites, exact additive functor U, underived comparisons and fixed two-injective Hom comparison chi of [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data, lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom], let Q,K,I be complexes with I K-injective, and q:Q to Hom(K,I). Apply the derived comparison to F(Q(q) followed by the inverse source Hom representative), then transport the inputs by the exact-localization factors. The result equals the localization factor on Q followed by Q of U(q) and the chain Hom comparison, followed by the inverse target Hom representative. There is no K-injectivity hypothesis on Q or K and no tensor or uncurrying assertion.

source.place: section-hom-complexes (08J9), K-injective resolutions 079P and localization 08J7; naturality extension in step 1 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-normalized-uncurry.

proof.text: Choose a K-injective resolution a:K to Kprime. Its localization Q(a) is an isomorphism, so the derived Hom map H(Q(a),id), and its image under F, are isomorphisms. It suffices to precompose both sides of the desired square by F(H(Q(a),id)).

Naturality of chi transports the derived Hom factor across this precomposition. Naturality of the inverse exact-localization factor gives the corresponding square in the contravariant variable. Naturality of the target representative isomorphisms then identifies the left side with the known two-injective representative equation for Kprime and I.

Apply naturality of the chain Hom comparison and the exact-localization factor on Hom. Naturality of the source representative isomorphisms identifies the remaining composite with the precomposed right side. Cancellation proves the desired square for K. Finally compose the representative equation with the inverse source and target representative isomorphisms. Precompose by F(Q(q)) and use naturality of the localization factor on q. This gives the displayed normalized formula for every map q into Hom(K,I).

theorem ringed_forget_hom_representative
    (Q K I : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
    (q : Q ⟶ homComplex (R := R) K I) :
    U.mapDerivedCategory.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map q ≫ (χ.source.iso K I).inv) ≫
        χ.derived.hom.app (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K), DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) ≫
        (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{d, vd, s, wa} J' R').map
          (X := (op (U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)),
            U.mapDerivedCategory.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)))
          (Y := (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)),
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
          ((U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app K).op,
            U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app I) =
      U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map q ≫
          χ.chain.hom.app (op K, I)) ≫
        (χ.target.iso ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
          ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I)).inv
